command: llvm-mc -triple=x86_64 -filetype=obj research/evidence/experiments/EXP-0091/probe.asm -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: The two 0.62.0 rows: the 0x67 movq no-base indexed shape (ModRM 04, SIB.base 101, disp32 mandatory) in both directions, with REX.W mandatory at byte 1. R ([10,1]) and X ([9,1]) are free bits of that byte, so the load/store rows cover all sixteen value registers and indexes: 48 is the low pair, 4c an extended value, 4a an extended index and 4e both, and every row is nine bytes. Corners: zero displacement, -8, the x4 scale (SIB 8d), %r12d as the index under REX.X (67 4a 8b 04 25 08 00 00 00) and 4660(,%r15d,8), %r15 (67 4e 8b 3c fd 34 12 00 00). 0x67 is byte 0, REX byte 1, the opcode byte 2, ModRM 04 byte 3 and SIB byte 4; the value is [10,1]+[27,3], the index [9,1]+[35,3], the scale [38,2] and the displacement [40,32]. There is no base slot, so no REX.B bit exists. input_sha256 is probe.asm; output_sha256 is the 117-byte .text.
